title: Keon Coleman: It's a make or break season for me

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Keon Coleman: It's a make or break season for me
sources.description: Bills head coach Joe Brady, quarterback Josh Allen and others in Buffalo have been steadfast in their support of wide receiver Keon Coleman since team owner Terry Pegula's comments about him after the team's playoff loss, but Coleman knows that there's a point where that support will come to an end.
